title: Production Plan — a dated run of intended output
description: A plan is intent, not movement: it names what is to be produced and how much, and it moves no stock at all. Its entries are what `run_plan` raises into work orders, each against the submitted bill of materials for that entry's item — which is why an entry names an item and a quantity and deliberately not a BOM id, so the plan does not pin a bill of materials revision it did not choose.

from_warehouse.description: The default source warehouse for the work orders the plan raises; an entry may override it.

to_warehouse.description: The default target warehouse for the work orders the plan raises; an entry may override it.

entries.description: The planned output. At least one entry: a plan that plans nothing is not a plan.

harvest: the production plan field surface (planned entries of item and quantity for a date)
a plan as intent that is raised into orders rather than a movement of stock
x-erp-provenance.note: Field and lifecycle shapes from the upstream production plan doctype, re-expressed as our own schema and workflow data. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied.
